column1: # Corpus names that belong to another dimension, are excluded, or are unresolved.
# Written 2026-10-06 from the two placement passes. This file is the handover to
# the ALGORITHMS derivation: `algorithm` rows are its vocabulary, already sized.
#   algorithm     -- a learning algorithm; belongs to the algorithms dimension
#   generic       -- a generic description; pins axis values, no lineage node
#   quarantine    -- uninformative generic the design excludes
#   misextraction -- a library, dataset, metric or tool that was never a model
#   unsure        -- undecided; the question is in `why`. Kept unresolved on
#   out-of-scope  -- a model from another field (ecology, cognitive science). Correctly
#                    extracted, but not a machine-learning architecture, and the research
#                    focus is ML (owner, 2026-10-06). Not a misextraction.
#                    purpose: a recorded question beats a confident wrong answer.
